rootFontNote: The 32px check sets font-size on documentElement. It is not native browser zoom, not a device, and not a screen reader.
correlationLimit: A changed valid list is a newly observed canonical snapshot. It does not identify which router.refresh produced it and does not prove the read followed an unknown write. Unchanged content stays unconfirmed. There is no server read nonce.
